sec.fullDesc: Columns drop one at a time by priority as the box narrows; headers never clip. Hover a row for its icons, ⋯ holds every action, s starts and t opens a terminal on the active row. Sorting is kept in the address.
sec.wrapsDesc: A column can let its text wrap instead of ending in an ellipsis: the row grows with it, and a row whose text fits keeps its height.
sec.iconsDesc: The folder grid (Files › Show › Icons): the row's lead cell large, its name under it. A click picks a tile, a double click or Enter opens it, a right click or . opens its row menu; arrows move in two dimensions.
sec.listDesc: When the name, status and one more column no longer fit, or beside an open detail: two lines per row, no header, one ellipsis at the end of line 2. ⚙ › Select rows turns on checkboxes.
sec.pick: Rows that open, with split actions
sec.notesDesc: GroupNotes: what a list grouped by computer says about one computer, as the group's first row. The group header names the computer, so the words do not; each action's name still says which computer it acts on. Above a list with no groups, each note names its computer.
sec.groupsDesc: Collapsible group rows, a row's parts in an indented sub-table (→ / ←), and a pager kept in the address. A group's note can sit at the row's end, in line with the ⋯ buttons.
sec.statesDesc: Loading, a failed read, stale data kept with a warning band, no match, and a capped read.
sec.layoutsDesc: Open the two ListDetailPage modes full size.
width.label: Box width
col.name: Name
col.sizeTip: The processor cores and the memory the computer has.
parts.title: Parts
detail.title: Computers
detail.banner: Two computers are waiting for a restart. This notice stays above both panes.
detail.pickBody: These computers belong to one realm. Choose one in the realm menu to see its list.
detail.body: The detail fills the rest of the width. Press \ to hide the list, Esc to go back to the row.
sec.stickyDesc: The header of the group in sight stays under the column header while its rows scroll by; the next group's takes its place. Virtual rows keep it drawn.
col.pathTip: The address the endpoint answers on.
sec.nestedDesc: A group can sit under another one level deep: the parent counts everything under it and closing it hides its children, each keeping its own state. With sticky headers the child in sight sticks under its parent.
group.agentText: Runs the coding agent: its sessions, the tools it calls and the answers it gives back to you.
group.filesText: Reads and writes the files on this computer, with the folders the agent may reach.
note.link: Open the long note written for this computer in the side panel
note.label: Notes kept for this computer
kept.label: Days the backups of this computer are kept
kept.tip: Older backups are removed on the next nightly run.
sec.chipsDesc: A chip with no value is its name and a caret. A set chip is one plate in three parts: name, value, clear. A long value is cut short; several values read in one line.
chips.longValue: The deploy key of the storefront build computer in Frankfurt
